title: Task input validation
description:
Source of truth: docs/thoughts/2026-09-17-increment-01-task-basics.md → 'Validation' table and 'Domain → validate.ts'. src/lib/tasks/types.ts (Task, TaskInput) exists on this branch: import TaskInput from it.

Deliver src/lib/tasks/validate.ts exporting:
  export type TaskInputErrors = { title?: string; notes?: string };
  export type ParseResult = { ok: true; value: TaskInput } | { ok: false; errors: TaskInputErrors };
  export const TITLE_MAX = 200; export const NOTES_MAX = 2000;
  export function parseTaskInput(raw: { title?: unknown; notes?: unknown }): ParseResult
Rules: non-string values are treated as ""; both fields are trimmed; title must be 1..200 chars after trimming ("Title is required." when empty, "Title must be 200 characters or fewer." when longer); notes 0..2000 ("Notes must be 2000 characters or fewer."). Report every failing field at once. Also export `formDataToRaw(formData: FormData): { title: unknown; notes: unknown }` returning formData.get("title") and formData.get("notes") so server actions have one way in.

Test cases (test-first) in src/lib/tasks/validate.test.ts (vitest node project):
- "  Buy milk  " → ok, value.title === "Buy milk", value.notes === ""
- "" → errors.title === "Title is required."
- "   " → errors.title === "Title is required."
- 201 chars → errors.title === "Title must be 200 characters or fewer."; exactly 200 chars → ok
- notes of 2001 chars → errors.notes === "Notes must be 2000 characters or fewer."; exactly 2000 → ok
- notes undefined → ok with value.notes === ""
- title 42 (a number) → errors.title === "Title is required."
- both invalid → both errors present
- formDataToRaw(new FormData with title and notes appended) → the two strings; missing keys → null values which parseTaskInput treats as empty

Files likely touched: src/lib/tasks/validate.ts (new), src/lib/tasks/validate.test.ts (new). Nothing else.
Run: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
